items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: We did have Big Chief, the trombone player... Indian, used to play with us. We did have him, but he left us.

ctx.x: We had Fernando. We got him from Noble Sissel. And we did have Big Chief, the trombone player that now plays with Lester Lanin, the society bandleader? That plays all over America? Well, Big Chief, their trombone player, [Russell Moore]-ed. Indian, used to play with us. We did have him, but he left us. And we had -- I'm trying to think who we had on trumpet. We picked up a boy in Chicago. Beautiful trumpet player. He used to play with Jimmy Lunsford. They later found that he was -- you know, and so we had to let…

man, he was great.

And we had another little boy in Chicago, used to sing.
